gxAnchorPointX.Description: Horizontal transform origin along the X axis; affects where resize, scale, and rotation begin

gxAnchorPointY.Description: Vertical transform origin along the Y axis; affects where resize, scale, and rotation begin

gxResize.Description: Shorthand for gxResizeX and gxResizeY at once

gxResizeX.Description: Horizontal resizing relative to the selected reference frame

gxResizeY.Description: Vertical resizing relative to the selected reference frame

gxResizeRelativoTo.Description: Reference element used to calculate resize distances and proportions

Options.current: Uses current control size as reference
Options.parent: Uses parent control size as reference

gxScaleRelativeTo.Description: Reference element used to calculate scale factors and resulting dimensions

Options.current: Uses current control size as reference
Options.parent: Uses parent control size as reference

gxTranslateRelativeTo.Description: Reference element used to calculate translation coordinates and offsets

Options.current: Uses current control as translation reference
Options.parent: Uses parent control as translation reference

gxTranslateType.Description: Translation behavior as target coordinates or relative displacement

Options.by: Translates by offset from current coordinates
